title: Replace the 8-project cap with a cross-project query budget that does not limit how many boards a tenant has
description: MAX_PROJECTS = 8 (services/kanbus-api/src/lib.rs:25) limits both the allowlist size (with_projects) and multi-project query selection. It exists as a Preview bound on exhaustive query fan-out (32 project/type streams, 1,000 catalog candidates), not as a storage constraint. Separate the two: the number of projects a tenant may own is unbounded; only a single cross-project query is bounded (and returns query_budget_exceeded with cost). Consider a tenant-level catalog index if org-wide cross-board views (all bots' cards) are needed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chatticus (2026-10-20): an organization-wide view across all of a tenant's bot boards is wanted later (not now). Keep the design able to list across every board of a tenant without naming each project in the query, e.g. a tenant-level catalog index or projects=* resolved within the budget for principals with a tenant-wide grant.
